sections.1__principes_directeurs:
Identité sonore (3 piliers)

1. Conflits de conscience  — cello, minor key, melancholic, rubato, dissonant, intimate, piano, introspective, chamber, sorrowful

1. Voyage au Cœur de l'Étrange  — theremin, ethereal, ambient, prepared piano, unsettling, granular, microtonal, mysterious, free tempo, otherworldly

1. Des liens d’acier — brass, triumphant, building, orchestral, resolute, percussion, heroic, anthem, crescendo, determined

Mots-clés conseillés : organic, textural, layered, modal, strings, woodwinds, drone, ostinato, hypnotic, meditative, ceremonial, warm, pensive, evolving, cyclic, polyrhythmic, sustained, ritual, liminal, dreamlike, frame drum, oud, bowed metals, sparse, wistful, enigmatic, uncanny, contemplative, flowing, delicate, rock, metal, epic choir, romantic, sentimental,

[Genre/Style] [opens/begins] at [BPM] BPM in [key]: [instrument principal] [verbe d'action fort] [description dramatique]. [Instruments secondaires] [verbe d'action], [descripteurs d'ambiance]; [moment clé] [verbe d'action fort]. Loopable core [timestamps]. [style tags positifs seulement]

- Transitions [expl → combat crossfade 500 ms]
sections.6__banque_de_prompts_suno___gabarits_rap:
Principes des prompts efficaces :

- IMPORTANT : Les prompts Suno sont TOUJOURS positifs (on ne décrit jamais en termes négatifs, jamais de “no X”)

- Max 500 caractères

- Structure narrative et cinématographique (ouverture → développement → climax)

- Verbes d'action puissants (erupts, collides, pierces, threads, pounds)

- Intégration organique des specs techniques (BPM/tonalité dans le récit)

- Vocabulaire sensoriel et concret (treated choir, metallic bowing, distant screams)

- Exclusions stylistiques stratégiques : exclure uniquement les styles adjacents ou susceptibles de remonter dans les résultats Suno. Ne pas exclure de styles sans rapport avec le prompt.

Format narratif :

[Genre/Style] [opens/begins] at [BPM] BPM in [key]: [instrument principal] [verbe action fort] [description dramatique]. [Instruments secondaires] [verbe action], [mood descriptors]; [moment clé] [verbe action fort]. [style tags positifs]

Note : Les styles à exclure vont dans le champ "Exclude styles" de Suno, pas dans le prompt principal.

Exploration – low intensity

Ethereal ambient exploration piece opens at 75 BPM in A minor: felt piano fragments drift over sustained string harmonics. Sparse granular textures emerge and recede; distant glass tones punctuate the mineral calm. Subtle 3-note descending motif threads through every 8 bars. textural, meditative, contemplative, spacious

Exclude styles: EDM, upbeat, pop — (évite les dérives rythmiques énergiques possibles avec "ambient")

Exploration → Combat (transitional)

Transitional cue begins at 95 BPM in D minor: ambient strings swell and dissolve into light spiccato pulses. Low toms punctuate softly; analog bass pulse emerge, building tension. Arrangement stays thin, allowing layering. organic, evolving, building

Exclude styles: bombastic, epic — (évite l'excès orchestral sur une transition qui doit rester légère)

Combat – folk horror intensity

Dark metal folk opens with eruptions of chaotic percussion and guttural screams at 120 BPM in Phrygian minor. Urgent folk rhythms steer tense verses; choruses erupt into layered folkloric melodies paired with aggressive vocals. The climax fuses martial drums, treated choir, unsettling theremin, and pounding frame drum. folk metal, alternative rock, ritualistic

Exclude styles: ambient, dark ambient — ("dark folk" peut dériver vers l'ambient atmosphérique, on veut du rythme agressif)

Puzzle/Tension – sparse

Minimal tension bed unfolds at 65 BPM in C minor with free-time feel: prepared piano ticks irregularly, bowed metals whisper and scrape. Reversed textures breathe in the low register; sustained drones hover beneath. Uneasy intimacy, no percussion groove. Very low dynamics. intimate, unsettling, sparse, contemplative

Exclude styles: melodic, rhythmic — (le piano et les métaux pourraient déclencher des patterns mélodiques/rythmiques, on veut la texture pure)

UI/Menu

Gentle menu theme flows at 85 BPM in D Mixolydian: plucked synth harmonics shimmer over warm pad layers. Soft keys add subtle melodic touches without dominating. Welcoming and clear, unobtrusive. warm, welcoming, ambient

Exclude styles: percussion, dramatic — (un BPM défini peut déclencher des rythmes, on veut rester aérien et discret)

Combat – medium intensity

Tense action cue drives at 120 BPM in E minor: tight taiko ensemble pounds relentlessly, muted electric bass throbs beneath hybrid strings. Subtle braams punctuate 4-bar phrases; minimal cymbal wash maintains focus. The rhythm locks into a driving, martial pulse.focused, driving, aggressive

Exclude styles: epic, orchestral — (garde la densité contrôlée, évite les cuivres massifs typiques de ces styles)

Diegetic – tavern

Medieval tavern source track lilts at 90 BPM in G major 3/4: wooden lute plucks a simple melody, small drum taps gently, wooden flute weaves between phrases. Cheerful but subdued, slight room ambience. diegetic, acoustic, folk, medieval

Exclude styles: modern, synthesized — ("folk acoustic" peut générer des sonorités contemporaines, on veut l'authenticité médiévale)

Boss – phase 2 (enraged)

A brutal Slavic folk horror piece opens at 130 BPM in B Phrygian minor: cello ostinato collides with a relentless hurdy-gurdy drone. Fast drums pound, loud choir threads ominously, with sharp dulcimer stabs and metallic bowing; sudden distant screams pierce the gloom. Phase 1 motif inverted and distorted. mystic, alternative rock, classical

Exclude styles: ambient, dark ambient — (instruments traditionnels + "mystic" peuvent tirer vers l'ambient contemplatif, on veut de l'intensité)
